{{SameName|Undead|[[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Trick or Threat Town]] • [[Undead (Solar Eclipse)|Solar Eclipse]]}} {{EventEnded|date = 8th of May 2021|event = [[Halloween 2020 Event]]}} {{For|other uses of [[Undead (Disambiguation)|Undead]]}} {{Zombie |title1=Undead |image1 = Undead0.png |mode_appearance = [[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]] |first_wave_appearance = 1 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]35 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2.2) |spawned_by = [[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)|Reaper]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A dreadful night isn't it?
Kids should be outside 'trick or treating' for candy..
Instead, we have brains to pick..
If you survive to the end, I'll give you a nice treat!
Goodluck.{{sic}} You'll need it|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 1 ([[Trick or Threat Town]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Undead''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]], and was the first enemy to spawn, as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. Being the first enemy that spawned it had average health and a slightly slow speed. The '''Undead''' could also be spawned by the [[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)|Reaper]]. ==Appearance== The '''Undead''' had green skin, and its torso and legs were brown. Its rib and right leg were cut open and exposed. Bone could be seen in these cuts. It also had a shocked face. Its head was slightly tilted downwards. ==Strategy== *A few Level 2 [[Military Base]]s can clear multiple '''Undeads''' out easily. *Since the '''Undead''' spawn in groups, multiple [[Mortar]]s are useful against it. *A Level 2 [[Ace Pilot]] fares well against the '''Undead'''. *The [[Minigunner]] fares well against the '''Undead''', though you must wait a few waves before you can place it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TDSHalloweenIcon.png|'''Undead''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Halloween Trailer|'''Undead''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The shocked face on the '''Undead''' is based on the ﾟдﾟ emoticon, popularized from 2channel. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Undead''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Undead''' removed. {{TrickTown|Start|N/A|Undead|Wave 1|[[Mummy (Trick or Threat Town)|Mummy]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Undead}}
